pacing.note: Common Core prescribes no pacing. There is no CCSS equivalent of a DBE Annual Teaching Plan - term and week placement is a state, district or school decision, so no `terms` array is emitted. A scheduler wanting US pacing must source a district scope-and-sequence, which is a different document with its own rights position.
